messages:
maria: quick sync — need to lock scope for the next cycle's 'Ops Pulse' work. Candidate surface: dashboard templates (cost / error / latency), tracing hooks (span tagging + lightweight sampling), per-customer cost breakdown, and error analytics with runbook links. We have a ~6-week dev window. Which of these are must-haves for GA vs phase 2?
aj: FYI tracing hooks are the biggest tech risk. Adding tags + propagated spans increases ingest. We can get an MVP (sampling + tag propagation) in ~4w infra + 2w frontend if we limit sampling and model-scope.
samir: agree with aj. Important for SLOs: tracing overhead must stay <5% p99 latency impact. Proposed defaults: sample 5% overall, 0.5% for very high-volume routes. Example config: ```
sampling: {
  default: 0.05,
  overrides: {"/api/generate": 0.005}
}
```
katie: heads-up: customers (Acme, OmniHealth) explicitly asked for per-route and per-team cost attribution. That's a strong enterprise play — would call per-route cost a must-have for GA for sales motion.
dan: UI note — keep GA templates simple: KPI cards + quick drilldowns. Correlation / fancy charts should be Phase 2. If we try to ship correlation in GA it'll blow scope.
maria: proposal: Phase 1 (GA) = dashboard templates (cost/err/latency) + basic per-route cost breakdown + tracing hook MVP (sampling + span tags) + rollout toggles/canary. Acceptance: working examples for 3 customers + perf under synthetic load (verify sampling config and p99 impact). Phase 2 = error analytics & runbook linking, correlation charts, RBAC and exports.
aj: timeline check: Phase 1 = ~6w total (4w infra + 2w frontend). Infra needs: KV slot for trace tag indexing, small storage and write throughput increase. Can we cut anything? Suggest postponing historical per-customer exports to Phase 2.
samir: also we need canary policy defined: 10% traffic for 48h, auto-rollback if error rate delta > 0.5% absolute. I'll add that to the runbook and test harness.
maria: owners: aj (infra), dan (frontend), samir (reliability), katie (customer validation). Action: owners to post clear acceptance criteria by EOD Friday. @deploy-bot please create a tracking ticket.
deploy-bot: created ticket OPS-4123 — "Ops Pulse Phase 1 scope" assigned to aj. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4123
katie: I'll gather customer example queries + day-to-day cost questions. Acme specifically asked for daily cost-delta alerts.
dan: mockups incoming tomorrow, will keep them low-fi and mobile-friendly. :eyes:
aj: noted. I will carve infra spike ticket and estimate CPU/storage impact for cost dashboards. Quick question — do we want embedding-based error clustering in Phase 1? my vote: no, push to Phase 2.
maria: agreed, no clustering in Phase 1. Final checklist for GA signoff: owners + acceptance criteria posted, canary policy in place, perf budget validated. Everyone okay?
aj: :thumbsup:
samir: :+1:
katie: :raised_hands:
dan: :rocket:
